resource_annotations.title: Ribosomes
resource_annotations.description: Ribosomes are cellular structures responsible for protein synthesis. They function as molecular machines that read the genetic information encoded in RNA and use it to assemble amino acids into proteins.

resource_annotations.title: Plasmid
resource_annotations.description: A plasmid is a small, circular piece of DNA that exists independently of the chromosomal DNA in a cell. It can carry genes that provide various advantages to the host organism.

resource_annotations.title: Cytoplasm
resource_annotations.description: Cytoplasm is the gel-like substance found inside a cell that plays a crucial role in supporting cellular processes, providing a medium for chemical reactions, and facilitating the movement of materials within the cell.
